CustomField.description: The rate you want to accrue at for the rebate program member. This rate is in the same units as the specified measure type, for example percent or amount. This field is available in API version 52.0 and later.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The rate of accrual based on the value selected in the Measure Type field. For example, if the measure type is percent and you enter 10, the accrual rate is 10%. This rate is used only for the Classic execution type.
